'''Berner Sport Club Young Boys''' ('''YB''' by short abbreviation, {{IPA|gsw|ˈiːbɛ|lang}} {{respell|EE|beh}}) is a Swiss professional [[sports club]] based in [[Bern]], Switzerland. Its first team has won 17 Swiss league championships and eight [[Swiss Cup]]s. YB is one of the most successful Swiss football clubs internationally, reaching the semi-finals of the [[UEFA Champions League|European Cup]] in the [[1958–59 European Cup|1958–59 season]]. The club's colours are yellow of a golden shade and black."}}
